JSXGraph 1.14.0, vendored for offline numerical curve generation.

Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/jsxgraph/-/jsxgraph-1.14.0.tgz
Documentation: https://jsxgraph.org/docs/

The distribution JavaScript is unmodified. License and bundled-code notices are included alongside
it. JSXGraph is dual-licensed under MIT or LGPL; this project uses its MIT license option.
No stylesheet is needed because the graph helper uses NoRenderer and emits its own SVG.
